reason: Adds a composer interface for searching current-workspace files and directories and inserting them as @ mentions, with configurable indexing and keyboard navigation.

summaries.zh: 在输入框中搜索当前会话工作区的文件和目录，并通过键盘选择将其插入为 @ 提及。
summaries.en: Searches files and directories in the current session workspace and inserts selected items as @ mentions from the composer.

capabilities: Indexes file and directory paths within the current session workspace
Provides prioritized fuzzy search and keyboard selection in the composer
Inserts selected workspace paths as plain-text @ mentions
Stores configurable indexing and mention settings
Exposes same-origin endpoints for search, settings, status, and index rebuilding
